summary: Master the art of finance and investment with our expert-led training course. Gain practical knowledge to boost your financial literacy and investment success.
lede: Investment training helps finance professionals compare opportunities and support capital decisions with evidence. Learners practice analyzing financial statements, appraising projects with present value and return measures, and assessing portfolio and financial risks using Excel-based workflows. They also build forecasts and prepare clear recommendations for technical and non-technical stakeholders.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who need to work with finance data, compare investment options, and support capital decisions with practical analysis.
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic working knowledge of business finance and be comfortable using spreadsheets. No programming is required, but you should be able to read a balance sheet, income statement, and cash flow statement, and you should bring a laptop with Microsoft Excel installed for the hands-on financial modeling exercises.
